description: This file defines a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_count_characters' used to compile code that counts characters in a text, either via UTF-8 mb_strlen or strlen fallback, for use within Smarty templates.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_count_characters
methods.description: Compiles PHP code to count characters in a variable, using mb_strlen if available and requested, otherwise strlen fallback.
